title: Doctoral Recruitment Call 2026 - Social Sciences, Humanities & Cultural Studies (SSH Call 2026), University of Vienna
program_type: Central annual recruitment call for salaried predoctoral (Praedoc) positions at a doctoral school
description: The University of Vienna's SSH Call 2026 is a central recruitment call offering at least 40 fully funded four-year doctoral positions in the social sciences, humanities and cultural studies across nine participating doctoral schools, including the Vienna Doctoral School in Cognition, Behavior, and Neuroscience (CoBeNe). Positions are 30 hours per week under collective bargaining agreement §48 VwGr. B1, paid at a monthly gross salary of EUR 2,786.10 paid 14 times per year, and employees are exempt from tuition fees. Applications for the 2026 round ran from 7 January to 2 March 2026 at 14:00 CET

title: DAAD Research Grants in Germany (for doctoral candidates and early postdocs)
program_type: Research stay grant for doctoral candidates and early postdocs
duration: 2 to 12 months for doctoral candidates; 2 to 6 months for postdocs
description: The DAAD Research Grants in Germany fund a research project at a state or state-recognised university or non-university research institute in Germany, carried out with a German scientific supervisor. Doctoral candidates may be funded for 2 to 12 months and early postdocs for 2 to 6 months; the grant cannot be extended and cannot be split within the funding period. title: DAAD University Summer Courses offered in Germany for Foreign Students and Graduates (HSK)
program_type: Short-term German language and cultural studies summer course grant (Hochschul-Sommerkurse, HSK)
duration: 4 weeks (maximum 5 days per week, at least 25 teaching hours per week)
description: The DAAD University Summer Courses programme funds four-week German language, cultural studies and technical language courses at German universities and affiliated language schools for students and graduates from eligible countries. The scholarship covers the cost of the language course, provides accommodation in a single room through the course provider for the duration of the course, pays a one-time allowance of EUR 475, a country-specific travel allowance, and health, accident and personal liability insurance. title: DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme (Master's Scholarships for Public Policy and Good Governance - PPGG)
program_type: Full master's scholarship for public policy and governance studies at selected German universities
duration: Duration of the selected master's course, normally two years; preceded by a German language course in Germany of up to six months
description: The DAAD Helmut-Schmidt-Programme, also known as Public Policy and Good Governance, is funded by the German Federal Foreign Office and supports future leaders from developing and emerging countries who want to promote democracy and social justice in their home regions. It funds places on selected English-taught master's courses in public policy, good governance, international relations, public management, public administration, civil society, geo-governance, peace and conflict studies, and development and socio-economic policy at seven German higher education institutions. title: DAAD Study Scholarships - Postgraduate Studies in the Fields of Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film
duration: 10 to 24 months for a Master's/postgraduate degree course; one academic year (usually 12 months) for complementary studies without degree
description: DAAD study scholarship for graduates in the arts to continue their education in Germany with a postgraduate or complementary course in Fine Art, Design, Visual Communication and Film. Funding covers a Master's/postgraduate degree course or a one-year complementary course without degree at a state or state-recognised German university. The scholarship pays a monthly stipend of EUR 992 plus a travel allowance, a one-off study allowance and insurance payments; it does not pay tuition fees. title: DAAD Study Scholarships - Postgraduate Studies in the Field of the Performing Arts
duration: 10 to 24 months for a Master's/postgraduate degree course; one academic year (usually 12 months) for complementary studies without degree
description: DAAD study scholarship for graduates in the performing arts to continue their education in Germany with a postgraduate or continuing course of study. Funding covers a Master's/postgraduate degree course or a one-year complementary course without degree at a state or state-recognised German university. The programme funds projects in the artistic field of the performing arts: Drama, Theatre Directing/Theatre Dramaturgy, Musicals, Performance Studies, Dance and Choreography. The scholarship pays a monthly stipend of EUR 992 plus a travel allowance, a one-off study allowance and insurance payment
